notes: New: macOS version (Apple Silicon and Intel) for Aerowinx PSX, with the same panel, mapping, brightness, Hardware Test, firmware upload, update and support features as Windows. Download MS747_MCP_Router_mac_latest.zip; first launch: right-click the app and choose Open.

Your settings are now kept in your user profile, so updates, re-extracted ZIPs and new installs in any folder keep your mapping, Direction Reverse, acceleration, brightness and PSX address. Existing settings are copied over automatically on first start.
